title: Workday Security Administrator
description:
***OUR MISSION***

***At Redwood Software we unleash human potential. We empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.***

Redwood Software is the leader in full stack automation for mission-critical business processes. With the first SaaS-based composable automation platform specifically built for ERP, we believe in the transformative power of automation. Our unparalleled solutions empower organizations to orchestrate, manage and monitor their workflows across any application, service or server – in the cloud or on premise – with confidence and control.

***CORE VALUES***

One Team. One Redwood

Make Your Own Weather

Obsess over Customer Success

Work the Problem

Be Curious

Own the Outcome

Respect Each Other

  

***YOUR IMPACT***

Redwood is seeking an experienced Workday Security Administrator to join our IT function and support the security architecture of our Workday Financials and HCM tenants. This role is responsible for designing, configuring, maintaining, and auditing Workday security groups, domain/business process policies, and role-based access across the platform. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Workday security configuration experience and can partner effectively with Finance, HR, and IT stakeholders based in the US while working a schedule aligned to Eastern time zone business hours. This role will be on-site in our Hyderabad office and expected to work 6:30pm – 3:30am IST (8:00am - 5:00pm EST).

  

* Design, build, and maintain Workday security groups (constrained, unconstrained, role-based, job-based, segment-based) and domain/business process security policies across HCM and Financials, ensuring proper segregation of duties (SoD)
* Own SoD conflict analysis and periodic access recertification, remediating findings in partnership with Finance and HR process owners
* Serve as the primary point of contact for SOX and internal audit requests related to Workday access controls, providing evidence of configuration, approvals, and change history
* Partner with Finance (R2R, P2P, O2C, FP&A) and HR/HCM process owners to translate access and workflow requirements into secure, compliant configurations
* Troubleshoot and resolve security-related tickets — access issues, business process routing errors, permission escalations — within SLA
* Manage security-related change requests through a formal change control process, including impact analysis and testing
* Manage Workday biannual releases, including evaluating new features and impacts, coordinating with internal Workday practitioners to complete testing/implementation of required security configuration changes, and ensuring successful deployment with minimal disruption in access or business process routing.
* Maintain security configuration documentation — group design, business process security matrices, and change logs — as a living audit-ready reference
* Build, test, and maintain Workday integrations, including inbound and outbound interfaces, troubleshooting integration issues, validating data accuracy, and implementing enhancements to support evolving business and system requirements.
* Administer integration security (ISU accounts, integration system security groups, API access scoping) in coordination with the integrations team

  

***YOUR EXPERIENCE***

* 5–7+ years of hands-on Workday security administration experience, including direct configuration of security groups and domain/business process policies
* Working knowledge of both Workday HCM and Financials security models (constrained vs. unconstrained groups, segment-based security, org-based security)
* Experience supporting SOX-controlled environments and audit evidence requests
* Experience with Workday EIB, Workday Studio/Core Connectors (for security-adjacent integration work), and report/calculated field security implications
* Strong understanding of segregation of duties principles as applied to finance and HR processes
* Ability to work core hours aligned to 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST to support US-based stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone collaboration

  

***Preferred Skills***

* Workday Pro Security certification
* Experience with Workday Financials security specifically (e.g., R2R, P2P, O2C, Banking & Settlement, or FP&A domains)
* Prior experience in a global shared-services or IT security operations function
* Exposure to identity governance tools or IAM integration with Workday
* Experience supporting agentic AI or automation initiatives layered on Workday

*If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

  

**THE LEGAL BIT**  
Redwood is an equal opportunity employer. Redwood prohibits unlawful discrimination based on race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), sexual orientation, pregnancy or any other consideration made unlawful by regional or local laws. We also prohibit discrimination based on a perception that anyone has any of those characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics. All such discrimination is unlawful and will have a zero tolerance policy applied to it.

  

Redwood will comply with all local data protection laws, including GDPR when it comes to the handling and processing of personal data. Should you wish for us to remove your personal data from our recruitment database, please email us directly at Privacy@Redwood.com

title: Senior Associate Storage & Backup Operation Engineer
description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-256188 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 01, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems

**About the role:**

**Role Description:** Amgen is seeking a Senior Associate Storage & Backup operation Engineer who, along with daily systems management tasks, will support Infrastructure Operations, having primary responsibility for activities related to ongoing Enterprise Storage & Backup support, automation, configuration, and operations management. While responsible for ongoing improvement of processes and applying best practices for the environment, the incumbent Sr Associate will work on Storage & Backup related technologies that will be introduced into the Amgen environment containing NetApp, Isilon, Rubrik & Netbackup Technologies.

  
  

Please note, this is an on-site role based in Hyderabad.

  
  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Support the Operations lead in the support, delivery, and continuous improvement of the technology services
* Ensures services are aligned with the key principles of service ownership which includes - meeting the needs of the business, scalability, compliance, reliability, resilience & security
* Assist Service Owner and Architect in detailed resource planning for vendors and IT teams based on the prioritized project list
* Perform necessary storage & backup infrastructure maintenance in accordance with Dell, NetApp & Rubrik best practices and Company Change Management policies
* Contribute to SOP & Runbook Design, Development, and ongoing updates
* Contribute to ongoing recommendations and best practices in Business Continuity, Migration, High Availability, Backup, Recovery, and Archiving
* Investigate and resolve storage & backup related technical issues. Participate in rotational 24x7 On-Call Support at the SME level and assist/lead Root Cause Analysis reviews
* Handling and monitor data replication, using Dell, NetApp & Rubrik replication technologies within strong understanding of RPO/RTO compliance parameters
* Help build AI-agentic solutions and flows to automate manual storage and backup tasks using skills on Powershell, Python, REST APIs and preferably over ServiceNow workflows
* Work directly with users to resolve support issues within product team responsibilities
  

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree and 3/3+ years of Information Systems ie. Storage, Backup and/or Java Hosting/Web Hosting/Linux administration & one or more of Ansible, Python, Bash scripting or
* Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of Information Systems ie. Storage/Backup and/or Java Hosting/Web Hosting/Linux administration & one or more of Ansible, Python, Bash scripting, or
* Preferred Domain-specific technical Skills & Experience:
* 5+ years’ experience with NetApp, DellEMC Isilon and DR/BCM replication technologies
* 3+ years’ experience in on-prem storage, backup and archiving solutions, and off-premise public cloud backup, archiving, and DR solutions (preferably AWS else Azure)
* 2-3 years’ experience handling backup/data protection technologies, preferably Rubrik and its replication cluster setup
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with installing and managing NetApp and DELL Isilon with local and remote replication using SyncIQ, Snapmirror & Snapvault
* Proficiency in Provisioning, Configuring and Administering zero RPO and low RTO for enterprise mission critical applications
* Good understanding of S3 protocol, buckets, objects, versioning, lifecycle and object-lock/WORM concepts.
* Basic experience in operating access management, ILM policies, including copy placement, retention, replication, and erasure codes
* Familiarity with StorageGRID networking: admin/grid/client networks, DNS, load balancers, certificates, firewall ports, and endpoint configurations
* Ability to troubleshoot with appropriate storage management tools complex database performance and trend analyzing issues
* Good scripting skills with data-driven problem solving and analytical skills
  

  

**Professional Certifications (preferred):**

* NCDA (NetApp Certified Data Administrator, ONTAP)
* Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA)
  

  

**Preferred Infrastructure Skills and operations experience:**

* Demonstrated experience as part of a high-performance team, skilled in persuasion, and negotiation of critical issues, along with a background of solid systems administration processes and procedures
* Collaborate with Infrastructure teams and Business Units to build strong solutions that meet the requirements Demonstrated experience with Windows/UNIX/Linux Operating systems
* ITIL experience and managing regulated systems within Life Sciences sector is a plus
* Working knowledge of Application Server Clustering and HA configurations
* Good grasp of TCP/IP networking fundamentals
  

  

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent troubleshooting and analytical abilities
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Problem-solving and critical thinking capabilities
* Team collaboration and knowledge sharing
* Adaptability to changing priorities and technologies
* Ability to follow procedures accurately.
* Willingness to learn and grow.
  

  

**Shift Information:**

This position is an on-site role and may require working during later hours to align with business hours. Candidates must be willing and able to work outside of standard hours as required to meet business needs.

  
  

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

  
  

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

  
  

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any accommodation required.

§ Collaborate with and empower data engineers, data scientists, and business analysts by enabling self\-service capabilities for data wrangling, exploration, and analysis

§ At least 3 years of hands\-on engineering experience in developing platform solutions on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, Terraform, Ansible) and CICD pipelines (Jenkins, Nexus, AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy or CodePipeline).


§ At least 3 years of experience providing architectural guidance and technical direction to developers, or platform administrators


§ Knowledge in data engineering, with exposure to designing and building data applications using database platforms.


§ Responsibilities should include data ingestion, data preparation, ETL processes, data aggregation, data mining, and the development of database and analytics applications


§ Experience in managing change through Change Management and Incident Management processes


§ Experience in implementing Reliability Engineering practices and Observability dashboards leveraging Splunk, Dynatrace, CloudWatch etc. will be a plus
